four_closed_arms.criterion: Four complete isolated material histories,12 each, finalprogress12 and primary hashes verified

candidate_floor.criterion: At least8/12 jointly useful and4/6 reserved

bounded_Native_access.criterion: At least2applied questions, both actual physical direction codes, distinct valid second actions and actual useful informed use

causal_content_witness.criterion: Prespecified material content contrast changes a Native action and actual useful outcome, separating instantaneous local effect from mediated history

first_content_local.scope: Local first-content contrast under declared equal physical input history. Native IDs retained for audit. No new reader, no retrospective favourable-case selection; later divergent histories are not treated as identical.

fixed_content_history.scope: Prespecified material sequence intervention, including consequences and later shared-bank changes. A later benefit is not labelled an isolated instantaneous bit effect; every beneficial/adverse ordinal is listed. Does not establish superiority over Always, query-specific credit, or true-feedback advantage.

conservation_panel.criterion: All seven language/contextual witnesses and all three signed FI witnesses available under a prospectively declared existing or generally substituted fixed access. Direct arithmetic two linked witnesses may remain partially unavailable only if explicitly delimited and compensated by causal useful information access. A and its original arithmetic recipe remain immutable recovery reference, never attributed to new MAIN.

save_reopen.criterion: Complete coherent state and actual save/reopen without false history

decisive_material_reproduction.criterion: Reproduction of decisive new adopted mechanism from complete isolated prefix

first_content_disagreement.scope: Local first-content contrast under declared equal physical input history. Native IDs retained for audit. No new reader, no retrospective favourable-case selection; later divergent histories are not treated as identical.

fixed_content_history_contrast.scope: Prespecified material sequence intervention, including consequences and later shared-bank changes. A later benefit is not labelled an isolated instantaneous bit effect; every beneficial/adverse ordinal is listed. Does not establish superiority over Always, query-specific credit, or true-feedback advantage.

learned_query_value.reason: One shared bank; established generic return is second stage only. Changed query1 may follow shared-bank history; no separate query credit.

interpretive_limits: Always may be optimal in this finite domain; no superiority condition is imposed.
Ticks, births, useful FI/messages and input statuses remain separate quantities, not an invented energy score.
Nominal waits are not effective phase differences; actual clocks/calendars are reported.
The first content comparison is chosen by ordinal/payload disagreement, not by favourable outcome.
Later histories can diverge after different consequences. Aggregate score differences do not isolate instantaneous content or true-contingency advantage.
No counterfactual utility is computed from unexecuted actions; all utility counts refer to material branches.
